lead_headline: Two Lazy Dogs dive bar opens downtown, Beard Papa's shutters after 5-year run, while Vintage Himalayan resurfaces under new detection

restaurant.blurb: 7 new leads today: Two Lazy Dogs dive bar (CBD), Vintage Himalayan reopening (Rosedale), both detected this morning. Closure: Beard Papa's dessert shop after 5 years.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications today, holding the 7-day count at 2,386 licenses as the mass-filing event continues its decay. The database anomaly — up 14,813% from the prior week's 16 filings — remains a system event (batch renewals or backend processing) rather than organic business activity. Friday's silence confirms the post-flood normalization, with weekly volumes expected to settle back to historical 20-30 baselines once the April surge fully clears from rolling counts.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention yesterday lifts the 7-day total to 43 across 14 sources — down 12% from last week's 49 and marking the slowest weekly pace since mid-April. Instagram (14) dominates this week's tally, trailed by Denver Post and Facebook (5 each), Reddit (4), and X (3). Thursday's lone pickup — an Instagram post about Harvey Park's new farmers market — underscores the week's social-heavy mix as traditional news outlets scale back April coverage. The 43-count pace runs 5% above April's 41-mention weekly average, but Thursday's anemic single-mention day signals May's opening has yet to spark editorial velocity.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled) advances MTD to +4 (+4.0/day), with 90-day net at +121. Thursday's modest gain continues the post-April 28th recovery, but the past week's −1 net (19 new, 20 canceled) reveals persistent churn undermining May's opening momentum — down from last week's +16 and confirming the April 28th cancellation spike's lingering drag. The 14-day view shows three consecutive positive days (May 1-2 contributing +4 combined) stabilizing after the 17-cancellation event, though the 7-day deficit means MTD's +4.0/day rate still trails YTD's +1.3/day baseline by 208%. May needs sustained low-churn conversion to reclaim Q1's stability.
